description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:463,491 — DeviationStore::active_for_lint and find_deviation take lint_id: &'static str. The target_lint stored in Deviation is &'static str (correct, it comes from Lint::id). But a caller who has a String lint ID (e.g., from dynamic config) cannot call these APIs without providing a &'static str. Change parameter type to &str — the comparison d.target_lint == lint_id works fine with &str because &'static str coerces to &str.
title: active_for_lint and find_deviation take &'static str where &str suffices
